We walked through the Cypress Wetlands in Port Royal with Jenn Clementoni from the Carolina Bight Birding Center. 

They are working to educate our community on the importance of birds in the Lowcountry and why they matter to our environment. Their goal is to build a center for education and bird rehabilitation to bring care closer to home. 

South Carolina STRONG.

Our resolution to release records of misconduct and harassment would have protected victims by redacting all personally identifiable information. Still, 357 members voted to block it and continue the cover-up.

We have made it our mission to bring the truth to light for both taxpayers and victims alike. It is deeply personal and incredibly important to give a voice to those who need it, and we are not afraid to do so.

Video
If illegal immigrants voted Republican, how fast would the Left be working overtime to deport every single one of them?

Affordability is top of mind for South Carolinians, and we’re making it a priority in Congress.

We’ve introduced legislation to hold Washington accountable for driving up the cost of living and to tackle the housing crisis so more South Carolinians can achieve homeownership.

Tax season has come to an end, and this year Americans are seeing more money back in their bank accounts than ever.

✅ No tax on tips
✅ No tax on overtime
✅ No tax on Social Security
✅ Small businesses saving an average of $7,000

We voted for legislation to ensure Americans keep more of their hard-earned money and to help lower the cost of living.

We have now received the files from our subpoena motion of Congress's taxpayer-funded sexual harassment slush fund. 

They reveal taxpayers have paid more than $300,000 in settlements paid on behalf of six former Members of the House of Representatives or their offices. 

Congress has spent decades hiding this from the American people. Taxpayers didn't sign up to foot the bill for cover-ups. They deserve to know their hard-earned dollars were used to cover up sexual harassment by their own elect

Happy Teacher Appreciation Week. 

To every teacher across South Carolina, thank you. You show up every single day for our children, educating and shaping the next generation of leaders. 

Your hard work does not go unnoticed and we will always support you.

If you are genuinely worried about illegal immigrant families being split up by deportations, stop encouraging them to come here and have anchor babies. 

Problem solved.

South Carolina is NOT a sanctuary state. It never will be.

Right here in the Lowcountry, we had a sanctuary sheriff named Kristin Graziano who refused to cooperate with federal immigration enforcement and put South Carolina families at risk.

We helped get her fired. Charleston County voters made it clear they don't want a sheriff who puts sanctuary policies over their safety. 

In South Carolina, we enforce the law and we protect our people.
Two illegal immigrants having a child in the United States does not make the child a citizen. It makes a third illegal. Time to close the loophole.

Happy National Nurses Day! 🩺

To every nurse and healthcare hero across South Carolina, thank you. You show up every single day, no matter what, to save lives and keep our communities strong.

South Carolina is ranked the fastest growing state in the country, but growth should mean opportunity, not a higher cost of living.

During our time in Congress, we've never voted to raise your taxes and never will. We've introduced legislation to weed out fraud stealing your tax dollars, make homeownership affordable, and we supported the largest tax cuts in American history. 

We're delivering for the great people of South Carolina.

Our office attended the Completion Celebration for the Hilton Head Island Airport Terminal Improvements Phase 1. 

This is a huge milestone for the Lowcountry. The airport already welcomed its first flight into the new terminal, marking a new chapter for Hilton Head Island. 

South Carolina STRONG.

Until we see arrests, the American people will continue to seek answers. And we will keep working to get them.

Last week, we were one of only a few Members of Congress to depose Ted Waitt, billionaire and boyfriend of Ghislaine Maxwell.

We will not stop until we deliver answers and justice. Not just because it is our job, but because it is our moral duty.

Video

WEEKLY UPDATE FROM WASHINGTON 🇺🇸

FARM BILL — FIRST TIME SINCE 2018
The House passed the Farm Bill this week, delivering for our farmers, ranchers, and rural communities. Our office filed eight amendments to improve the bill, and three were made in order by the Rules Committee and passed the full House:
